docs.doc: Defines the 5-story epic for integrating Definition dataset support into the Databento adapter. Contains architectural principles and all story acceptance criteria.
Existing documentation of Definition schema with 65 columns, instrument classification, parent/child relationships, and data patterns.
Analysis of current adapter limitations and recommendations for Definition integration. Identifies 5 key flaws and provides implementation roadmap.
Package overview and data locations for CME and NASDAQ datasets.

file.reason: Primary adapter implementation (~1239 lines). Contains DatabentoConfig, OHLCV parsing, symbology handling, and bundle output logic.
Shared utilities used by databento_adapter for symbol mapping and OHLCV preparation.
Base class and exceptions for all data adapters.
Writes OHLCV data to bundle Parquet files.

python.package: DataFrame operations for parsing and processing

constraints.constraint: Existing OHLCV ingestion must work without Definition package (current behavior preserved)
Definition provides optional enhancement layer, never required
Config additions must not break existing DatabentoConfig usage
Primary deliverable is exploration document, not production code

interface.name: DatabentoConfig
interface.signature: @dataclass DatabentoConfig: data_path: str, timezone: str = "UTC", extra_columns: list[str] | None = None, use_instrument_id: bool = True, symbol_format: str = "symbol_id"
interface.note: Current config - will need definition_package_path and include_user_defined_spreads additions

interface.name: DatabentoAdapter
interface.signature: class DatabentoAdapter(BaseDataAdapter, DataSource): fetch(), ingest_to_bundle(), _parse_ohlcv_csv(), _parse_symbology(), cleanup()
interface.note: Main adapter class implementing BaseDataAdapter and DataSource interfaces

interface.name: _parse_ohlcv_csv
interface.signature: _parse_ohlcv_csv(symbols_filter: list[str] | None, start: pd.Timestamp | None, end: pd.Timestamp | None) -> pl.DataFrame
interface.note: Key method for OHLCV parsing - Definition integration hook point
